Package com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent

Class AgentAttributes

java.lang.Object
com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.AgentAttributes
public final class AgentAttributes extends Object
Attributes used to create or update a Select AI Agent.

The database requires profile_name and role when the agent is created. The builder permits these values to be unset or blank; DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT validates the required creation values and the supplied attribute names and values when an update is attempted. The builder checks the documented shortTermMemoryLength range in Java.

To create a supervisor-led team, designate its supervisor with supervisor(true) at agent creation and reference that agent with TeamAttributes.Builder.supervisorAgent(String). The supervisor flag cannot be changed after creation. Worker agents remain separate from the supervisor in the team's agent-task mappings.

Since:
1.1.0
